items.question: Does the Unit 7 rent deposit earn interest for the tenant?
items.answer:
The documents do not state whether the Unit 7 rent deposit earns interest for the tenant.

The Unit 7 Lease specifies that the Tenant shall pay a rent deposit of GBP 21,000, to be held by the Landlord until the end of the Term [2]. However, there is no mention of interest being paid on this deposit.

The documents in this matter do not answer that.

evidence.quote: On the date of this Lease the Tenant shall pay a rent deposit of GBP 21,000, to be held by the Landlord until the end of the Term.

items.question: Who is Voss-Lindqvist's account manager at Harrowgate?
items.answer:
The documents do not identify Voss-Lindqvist's account manager at Harrowgate.

The sources mention that Calder & Wynne is advising Voss-Lindqvist AB on the renewal of its Master Services Agreement with Harrowgate Systems Inc. [1], and that the General Counsel of Voss-Lindqvist AB was addressed in a change of control notice [3]. However, no specific account manager is named.

The documents in this matter do not answer that.

evidence.quote: We will advise Voss-Lindqvist AB on the renewal of its Master Services Agreement with Harrowgate Systems Inc.

items.question: How often must Harrowgate be audited against ISO/IEC 27001 under the MSA?
items.answer: The documents do not specify how often Harrowgate must be audited against ISO/IEC 27001 under the MSA [3].
